title: Block Valley
summary: A block world everyone shares on the blocky kind's land: biomes, caves lit by crystals and glowcaps, lakes, the hills going on into the haze; place, break and paint blocks, saved on the play host.

verified.result: PASS gates 6/6, measures 16/16 (9, the contact sheet and perf, is not run for a world: frame cost is in kinds/sheets/blocky-world-record.json)
verified.kit: xgames-kit stream/voxel (the voxel world, the blocky kind and xk-voxel-blocks of this branch)
verified.how: node bin/gamesfun.mjs create <dir> --from block-valley, then node builder/tools/verify.mjs <dir> --all (a build verify of a world, every build measure; 93 s) under gpu-run.sh on Linux with a desktop GPU (CHROME_ARGS="--use-gl=angle --use-angle=gl-egl")
